plugins.name: Environmental Data
plugins.description: 环境数据查询，按需求比较适用性并获取获准详情；保留来源范围、证据与访问限制。
plugins.description_en: Find and match Environmental Data data to user requirements, compare applicability and retrieve authorized details while preserving provenance and access limits.
plugins.author: HiQ
plugins.requirements: 独立 CLI environmental-data 0.8.3；按固定摘要安装并核实程序范围，安装不授予数据权限。
plugins.requirements_en: Independent environmental-data 0.8.3; install with pinned hashes and verify scope. Installation grants no data entitlement.

skills.description: Find candidates, match requirements and retrieve authorized details from Environmental Data.

agents.description: 查找符合需求的环境数据候选，获取必要详情，说明来源与证据缺口。
将单项或清单需求逐项匹配到可辩护的环境数据候选，保留行身份、代理与未匹配项。
只读复核时间、地域、技术、单位、模型与证据适用性，不作审核认证。

plugins.recommended_prompt: 环境数据查询，复用我已提供的条件，查找候选、比较适用性并按需获取详情；保留证据、受限值与未匹配项，不擅自换来源。
plugins.recommended_prompt_en: Find and match Environmental Data data for my requirements; compare candidates and retrieve necessary authorized details, preserving evidence, restrictions and unresolved needs.
